title: Unitary Encoding of Thermal States via Thermofield Dynamics on Quantum Computers
summary: Quantum computing has attracted the attention of the scientific community in the past few decades. However, despite some relevant advantages, near-term quantum devices remain severely limited by thermal effects, which induce decoherence and restrict coherent control at finite temperature. In this regard, this work reports a gate-based quantum algorithm that prepares the finite-temperature vacuum of Thermofield Dynamics (TFD) and tracks its real-time evolution.
